instruction: Demonstrate how to change GIMP's theme to a dark appearance.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's theme setting to 'Dark'. Evaluator uses existing check_config_status metric to verify the 'theme' key in gimprc is set to 'Dark'. This is the inverse of the original task but same complexity level.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts GIMP's gimprc config file containing theme settings
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses the config file and checks for key-value match
Expected value format ('{"type": "key-value", "key": "theme", "value": "\"Dark\""}') matches GIMP's config syntax where values are quoted
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are written to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the exact requirement in the instruction (theme set to Dark)
Metric correctly handles the 'rule' parameter - when expected.type='rule', the framework passes the rules dict directly
Edge cases handled: None path check, comment/empty line skipping, support for both single and multi-part keys
